thread.title: Dow's early lift back above 25,000 powered by Apple, McDonald's shares - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Dow's early lift back above 25,000 powered by Apple, McDonald's shares - MarketWatch
text: The Dow Jones Industrial Average was trying to rebound on Wednesday from a downdraft in the previous session, with shares of McDonald's and Apple Inc. helping deliver an early boost for the average. Apple Inc.'s stock AAPL, +0.89% and those for McDonald's Corp. MCD, +1.54% were combining to contribute about 20 points to the price-weighted Dow. A $1 move in any of the 30 blue-chip components equates to a 6.89-point swing. The Dow DJIA, +0.42% most recently, was up 90 points, or 0.4%, at 25,046, the S&P 500 index SPX, +0.50% gained 0.4% at 2,728, while the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +0.59% advanced 0.5% at 7,272.
